descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S11 Hospital lifecycle: pre-round, Generate, Regenerate, pre-round re-save, reload (live AI)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)
  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note. (TFA-92589 AC 2; TFA-92589 description 1)
  • T3 Re-completing a note (Regenerate) never creates a second entry. (TFA-92589 AC 3; TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment)
  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.6; TFA-92589 AC 4)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fixture Hospital patient with no course

When Pre-Round Save Note → Generate Note & Finish → Regenerate → Pre-Round Save Note again with an afternoon update → reload

Then At every checkpoint there is exactly one card dated today. After Generate and after Regenerate it carries the encounter's facts and differs from the pre-round card. After the pre-round re-save it is still one card; whether its text may change is Q9

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs, scoped to the Course Timeline: '{day0}:' once in every checkpoint (U1/T3). cp-generated and cp-regen: an encounter-only fact present, no 'Encounter done', not the verbatim pre-round sentence, and today's card text differs from cp-preround's (T2). …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev/newspec-c.

Detail:

Dev, build e02167f, dataset course-hosp (QA DS1-course-hosp rows: 1 seeded + 6 added by the spec, all 7 deleted after, no other row changed). One Hospital patient with no course: Pre-Round Save Note, Generate Note & Finish, Regenerate Note on the same page, Save Note again with the afternoon update appended, then a fresh page load; the Course Timeline cards read on the Pre-Round tab at each step. Judged 19/19 cells held: exactly one dated card at every checkpoint and it is today's ('Oct 15:', U1 / T3); after Generate and after Regenerate it carries an encounter-only fact (furosemide), no 'Encounter done', placeholder, sign-off or copied pre-round sentence, and differs from the pre-round card (T2, the 'differsFrom' check the agent oracle lacks); noteGeneratedAt set; the stored course is one line. Recorded (Q9, not judged): the pre-round re-save replaced the finished-note entry ('79-year-old male ... improved crackles; continue furosemide with renal monitoring') with a pre-round one ('... Hypokalemia corrected with oral potassium replacement. Renal function stable') and the stored line now ends 'stable.. ⏳ Encounter pending.' although the note exists (the card strips the marker). Timing (S19 / U11, review only): generateNote about 5.3 s on us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5 with providerMs; none over 30 s.
